description: This Scala source file defines the RetryPolicy class and companion object for configuring retry mechanisms in Spark's gRPC client, including default policies, retry logic, and handling server-provided retry delays.

classes.name: RetryPolicy
classes.description: Case class representing retry configuration parameters for gRPC calls in Spark.

classes.name: RetryPolicy.RetryPolicyState
classes.description: Inner class managing the state of retries, including attempt count and wait durations.

methods.name: defaultPolicy
methods.description: Creates a default RetryPolicy with predefined retry parameters.

methods.name: defaultPolicies
methods.description: Returns a sequence containing the default RetryPolicy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the RetryPolicy.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts the RetryPolicy to its state representation.

methods.name: nextAttempt
methods.description: Calculates the wait duration before the next retry attempt based on the current state and error.

methods.name: canRetry
methods.description: Determines if a given Throwable is eligible for a retry based on the policy.

methods.name: defaultPolicyRetryException
methods.description: Default function to decide if an exception warrants a retry, based on gRPC status codes and RetryInfo.

methods.name: extractRetryInfo
methods.description: Extracts RetryInfo from a Throwable if available.

methods.name: extractRetryDelay
methods.description: Extracts the retry delay duration from RetryInfo in a Throwable.
